headline: Sarvam Dictate ready for trial, Patram 1.5 for assessment, and API caution urged

calls.title: Trial Sarvam Dictate for Multilingual Audio Transcription
calls.text: Integrate Sarvam Dictate API to transcribe multilingual client audio and calls. It supports English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute with significantly fewer character edits than competitors, cutting transcription costs and improving accuracy for DPA's workflows.

calls.title: Assess Patram 1.5 for Document Extraction Pipelines
calls.text: Test Patram 1.5 on 30 multilingual, low-quality fund reports to measure field extraction accuracy and abstention rates against our current pipeline. This open-weight vision-language model can enhance document processing for financial-services clients.

calls.title: Beware Data Leakage Risks in Foreign APIs
calls.text: Restrict unvetted foreign cloud AI APIs following reports of unauthorized data access. Re-enforce strict internal governance and data retention policies to protect sensitive client financial documents from exposure and regulatory breaches.
